reviews.summary: A fresh ORCA governance proposal creates near-term tokenomics, treasury-control, and governance uncertainty during this signal window; it was submitted September 29, 2026 and is subject to a multi-stage vote/execution process.
materialRisks: Pending proposal would shift protocol-fee allocation to 10% xORCA rewards, 10% discretionary team buybacks, and 80% team operations.
Proposal would transfer approximately 14.2M ORCA from the community treasury to a team-controlled strategic account for acquisitions.
Proposal would dissolve the Council and narrow tokenholder governance mainly to dilution decisions, creating material governance-utility uncertainty.

facts.fact: The official Orca forum proposal says its discussion period is at least 4 days, followed by a 5-day tokenholder vote and 2-day cooldown if passed; it was posted September 29, 2026. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))

The proposal specifies that all ORCA in the community treasury—about 14.2M ORCA—would move to a team-controlled Strategic Account. ([forums.orca.so](https://forums.orca.so/t/tokenholder-proposal-resourcing-orca-for-its-next-phase/1281?utm_source=openai))
No directly relevant fresh protocol exploit, outage, or regulatory action was identified in the reviewed sources.
